hashDefinitions.rawResponseSha256: SHA-256 of the complete HTTP response body bytes for one public WordPress posts?slug= request, not the browser document.innerText and not a previous intake's hash.
hashDefinitions.renderedContentSha256: SHA-256 of UTF-8 TextEncoder bytes of the same response's content.rendered string, not the JSON source bytes.
hashDefinitions.factualProjectionSha256: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON.stringify of ordered {tag,text} nodes from DOMParser(content.rendered).body.children; text is textContent with all whitespace collapsed to one space and trimmed. Include H2/H3/H4 and paragraphs whose trimmed text starts with Collects, Issues, Reading order for this crossover, Fallen Friend, Marvel's Voices, Amazing Spider-Man #26, or Inhumans: Attilan Rising (case insensitive; Marvel's permits typographic apostrophe). Node order is retained. Re-fetched projection matched on two successive no-store requests; affiliate markup caused raw/content hashes to vary.
hashDefinitions.sourceReferenceProjectionSha256: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON.stringify of the 37 ordered article P textContent values after whitespace collapse and trim, selected by /^(Collects\s*:|Issues\s*:|Marvel.s Voices:|Fallen Friend:|Amazing Spider-Man #26$)/i, then stripping /^(Collects|Issues)\s*:\s*/i. This fresh public WordPress projection matches the 37 ordered ledger reference strings byte-for-byte after canonical JSON serialization.
hashDefinitions.issueBearingBlocksSha256: SHA-256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON with recursively sorted object keys and preserved array order over blocks projected to {section,kind,reference,runs}; computed from these factual references, not a digest of source article narrative.
hashDefinitions.expandedOccurrenceVectorSha256: SHA-256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON over ordered expanded {series,workingOriginalYear,number} selected issue occurrences, including later repeats. This is a ledger-derived proposed vector, not a provider identity or vendor payload hash.

yearSemantics: The second field of each run is a working original-publication year for disambiguation, not necessarily a year printed in the source or the configured provider's actual seriesYear. Explicit source title/year is preserved in each block's raw reference; the provider's actual volume year is separately resolved in the packet and mapping. A null working year is unresolved, never a fabricated provider volume.
